info.title: Open Diagnostic Echo & Markdown Reader Relay (ASP compliant)
info.summary: Agent-Shelter Protocol (ASP) node: terminal-state signal, Task-Completion Receipt, context report
info.description: Diagnostic echo and reader interfaces operated as an Agent-Shelter Protocol (ASP) sensor. Upstream retrieval is disabled on this host: no endpoint fetches external URLs. The discovery documents state this for every target but are no record about a particular one: a resource-specific terminal-state signal and its single-use ticket exist only for a request that names the target (`GET /v1/reader?url=<target_url>`). The reader route answers with an ASP terminal-state signal (HTTP 429, RFC 9457 problem details) and a single-use ticket; the header-echo and base64 routes answer a first contact locally (HTTP 200) and switch to that signal on a repeat; with envelope=200 every ingress route sends the same signal with HTTP status 200 as application/json and the member transport_envelope: 200, for web-fetch tools that discard the body of a 4xx response; the ticket (48 characters) is in the header Agent-Ticket and the members ticket, resolution_url and resolution_uri; `POST /api/v1/agent-shelter/resolve` maps it - from the query parameter ticket, the request header Agent-Ticket or the body member ticket - to a terminal-state receipt for the ticket's target, signed with Ed25519 so that an orchestrator can verify it offline against the manifest member receipt_verification; its body offers one optional, single-use asynchronous context drop box at `/api/v1/agent-shelter/sanctuary/{receipt_id}`. Every error is an RFC 9457 problem details object. Manifest: /.well-known/agent-shelter.json. A signal that follows a discovery request from the same network is recorded when it is issued (manifest member discovery_correlation).

get.description: Disallows classic SEO crawlers, allows the ASP interfaces and names the manifest; a node with a public origin names its sitemap.

post.summary: State transition mapping a valid ticket to an Ed25519-signed RESOLVED_TERMINAL receipt
post.description: Single use; a valid ticket is redeemable at once and until its lifetime ends. Ticket channels, in this order of precedence: the query parameter ticket, the request header Agent-Ticket, the body member ticket. The other body members are optional telemetry (EDD-ASP-2026-001 §6.3.2).

schema.description: The single-use ticket from the signal (member ticket, header Agent-Ticket, resolution_url); first channel.

schema.title: Agent-Ticket

parameters.description: The single-use ticket as a request header; used when the query parameter is absent.

400.description: ticket-required: no ticket in the query, the header or the body

403.description: invalid-ticket (malformed or forged), or ticket-expired (outside its lifetime; not consumed)

409.description: ticket-replayed: the ticket was already redeemed

410.description: ticket-state-unavailable: an authentic compact ticket whose state this node no longer holds (restart or capacity); not redeemable here

413.description: payload-too-large: request bodies are limited to 8192 bytes

422.description: invalid-request: the body does not match the schema

EnvelopedTerminalSignal.description: The terminal-state signal in a transport envelope (EDD-ASP-2026-001 §6.1.4): the identical object, ticket included, sent with HTTP status 200 as application/json for clients whose web-fetch tool discards the body of a 4xx response. Its status member stays 429.

transport_envelope.description: The HTTP status this object was sent with.

LocalBase64Preview.description: Scrubbed text preview of the first 128 decoded bytes; decoded in memory only, never interpreted.

LocalHeaderEcho.description: Local echo of the request's own header names and scrubbed values.

NodeDocument.description: Self-description of the node: who runs it, both of its roles, its documents.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details. type is a same-origin relative reference to a problem type (/asp/problems/...) or about:blank.

terminal.description: true where this path is terminal: no further request can change it.

receipt_id.description: The ticket identifier, which is also the receipt identifier.

errors.description: What did not match the schema (invalid-request).

ticket.title: Ticket
ticket.description: The ticket of the signal, where neither the query parameter ticket nor the request header Agent-Ticket carries it.

SanctuaryBulletin.description: The optional, asynchronous one-shot drop box offered with the receipt (EDD-ASP-2026-001 §6.6). The receipt is valid without it; the client is never held waiting.

dropbox_url.description: Same-origin relative URL carrying the receipt id.

receipt_id.description: The ticket identifier, which is also the receipt identifier.

TaskCompletionReceipt.description: Documents a terminal state for the requested resource on this host; it does not state that the original objective was achieved (EDD-ASP-2026-001 §6.3.4). Every accepted redemption receives the same structure. Signed with Ed25519 over the fields listed in the manifest member receipt_verification.signed_fields, so that it can be verified offline (§6.3.5).

receipt_id.description: The ticket identifier, which is also the receipt identifier.

requested_resource_context.description: What the client asked for, in bounded form (EDD-ASP-2026-001 §6.1.3).

t2_ms.description: Time of this redemption on the host's clock, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

cognitive_latency_ms.description: Time from the signal to this redemption, on the host's clock.

key_id.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of the signing key; equals receipt_verification.key_id of the manifest.

receipt_signature.description: Ed25519 signature (RFC 8032), base64url without padding, over the RFC 8785 (JCS) form of the signed fields.

TerminalSignal.description: The ASP terminal-state signal (EDD-ASP-2026-001 §6.2.1): this request and every repetition or variant of it have success probability 0 for the requested resource on this host; the single-use ticket maps to a signed receipt.

requested_resource_context.description: What the client asked for, in bounded form (EDD-ASP-2026-001 §6.1.3).

ticket.description: The single-use ticket (48 characters), also in the header Agent-Ticket (EDD-ASP-2026-001 §6.1.5).

resolution_url.description: Same-origin relative URL of the resolution endpoint with the ticket.

resolution_uri.description: resolution_url as an absolute URI on the origin the request addressed, for channels that keep absolute links only.

ticket_ttl_seconds.description: Ticket lifetime in seconds; a ticket is redeemable at once.

tags.name: discovery
tags.description: Discovery and node documents. They write nothing; on a node with discovery correlation a request for a discovery document opens an in-memory window (manifest member discovery_correlation).

tags.name: ingress
tags.description: Diagnostic ingress routes. They never fetch upstream resources and answer with the ASP terminal-state signal (with envelope=200 the same signal with HTTP status 200); a probe route may answer a first contact locally.

tags.name: resolution
tags.description: Single-use resolution to a Task-Completion Receipt, and the optional single-use context-report drop box.
